description: Intelligent Network Flow Optimization Prototype Infrastructure Traffic Sensor System Data Aggregator is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by Battelle Memorial Institute -- Recommended citation: "Battelle Memorial Institute. (2015). [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504486". Data is from the small-scale demonstration of the Intelligent Network Flow Optimization (INFLO) Prototype System and applications in Seattle, Washington. Connected vehicle systems were deployed in 21 vehicles in a scripted driving scenario circuiting this I-5 corridor northbound and southbound during morning rush hour. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 16 columns, among them AvgSpeed, Occupancy, Volume, EndTime, BeginTime, IntervalLength. The portal shows 2017-09-27 as the last data update. Attribution given: Battelle Memorial Institute -- Recommended citation: "Battelle Memorial Institute. (2015). Intelligent Network Flow Opti. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
